title: Surreal Circular Portal
description: A circular cracked frame decorated with gears, butterflies, jars and mechanical elements encloses a surreal landscape. Within the frame, glowing green staircases rise from reflective water toward a distant lighthouse and fruit-bearing trees under a vibrant aurora borealis sky.
prompt: A surreal circular portal with a cracked white and purple frame adorned with gears, butterflies, glass jars and mechanical details. Inside the circle is a dreamlike landscape with glowing green staircases emerging from reflective water, a lighthouse on a small island with fruit trees, and a dramatic sky filled with vibrant red, yellow and green aurora borealis. Mystical atmosphere, painterly style with gold leaf accents.
